description: Compute the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio between a text (foreground) color and a background color, with pass/fail for AA, AA large text, AAA, AAA large text and non-text UI (3:1). Handles translucent colors. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/contrast.

background.description: Background color as a CSS color: "#1a73e8", "#fff", "rgb(26 115 232)", "hsl(217 80% 51%)", "rgba(0,0,0,.6)" or a name like "navy".

foreground.description: Text / foreground color as a CSS color: "#1a73e8", "#fff", "rgb(26 115 232)", "hsl(217 80% 51%)", "rgba(0,0,0,.6)" or a name like "navy".

name: check_contrast
title: Check WCAG color contrast
